landing_intro_nws: Simple Weather queries the US National Weather Service to provide a responsive weather forecast. Use your current location or a full US street address below.
landing_intro_global: Simple Weather queries Open-Meteo to provide a responsive worldwide forecast. Use your current location or search for a city below. US forecasts via the National Weather Service are also available — see the NWS / OpenMeteo switcher in the top nav bar.
landing_geolocate_body_nws: Asks for location permission and shows your forecast if you're in the United States.
landing_geolocate_body_global: Asks for location permission and shows your forecast anywhere in the world.
landing_geolocate_blocked: Location access is blocked in your browser settings — you can still search below.
landing_search_body_global: Uses the Open-Meteo geocoder. A city name is enough. Example: Berlin, Germany.
landing_search_body_nws: Uses the Census Bureau geocoder. A full street address is needed. Example: 1600 Pennsylvania Ave SE, Washington, DC.
landing_search_hint: Pick one of up to 5 matches.
error_geolocation_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported in this environment.
error_geolocation_denied: Please enable location access to see your local forecast.
error_geolocation_unavailable: Unable to determine your location. Please try again.
error_geolocation_timeout: Location request timed out. Please try again.
error_geolocation_generic: Unable to get your location. Please try again.
error_address_empty: Please enter a search to continue.
error_address_not_found: Location not found. Please check the search and try again.
error_address_failed: Unable to search for that location. Please try again.
weather_chart_caption: High {high} • Low {low} • Bars show chance of precipitation (right axis).
weather_footer_openmeteo: Forecast data by Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com). Location data © GeoNames. Place names © OpenStreetMap contributors.
